verdict.rationale: Brex offers an official MCP server that lets AI assistants "manage expenses" and review transactions, plus a transactions API for reading spend data, so an external agent can pull expense and transaction data. Policy-violation data is exposed only on travel booking objects. Brex's own built-in AI agents categorize spend and flag violations, but that is first-party automation, not an external agent pushing coding back through the API. Missing for 10: a documented filter for uncoded or uncategorized transactions, documented API/MCP write-back of categories or GL coding into a review queue, policy flags on general card transactions (not just travel bookings), and independent or hands-on corroboration.
